title: Rait se processor kaise banta hai?
hooks: Rait... aur usse nikalta hai tera processor. Socho kaise?
Kya aapko pata hai aapka phone rait se bana hai?
Processor banane ka asli tarika dekh lo.
hook_why: Uses a visceral transformation (sand to processor) to trigger instant curiosity with a conversational 'Socho kaise?'
metaphor: Skyscraper: Building a chip floor-by-floor using light and chemicals until the tiny structure is complete.
mechanism: Clean room and FOUPs for contamination control

scenes.vo: Rait... aur usse nikalta hai tera processor. Socho kaise?
scenes.prompt: Cinematic macro shot: golden sand grains flowing, then hard match-cut to a pristine silicon ingot glowing on pure black.
scenes.title: RAIT SE CHIP
scenes.bg_prompt: Macro photograph of golden sand grains on black background, studio lighting.
scenes.label: HOOK

scenes.vo: Pehle, ultra-saaf 'Clean Room' jahan dhool ka ek tinka bhi mana hai.
scenes.prompt: A sealed plastic FOUP box moving on an automated overhead track in a futuristic blue-lit factory.
scenes.title: CLEAN ROOM

real.subject: A highly controlled, spotless clean room environment with technicians in full cleanroom suits, emphasizing cleanliness.

scenes.bg_prompt: Semiconductor fab interior, high-tech automated material handling system, nitrogen-filled FOUPs.
scenes.label: ENVIRONMENT

scenes.vo: Rait ko pighla kar chamakti 'Ingot' yaani shuddh silli banate hain.
scenes.prompt: A single crystal silicon ingot, mirror finish, standing upright on a black pedestal.
scenes.title: SILICON INGOT

real.subject: A close-up, industrial photo of molten silicon or a polished silicon ingot, suggesting high purity.

scenes.bg_prompt: Photorealistic studio shot of a monocrystalline silicon ingot, sharp edges.
scenes.label: PURIFICATION

scenes.vo: Isse mirror jaisi patli 'Wafers' yaani CD jaisi plates kaat-te hain.
scenes.prompt: A 300mm silicon wafer held by vacuum tweezers, reflecting a single studio light.
scenes.title: WAFER SLICE
scenes.bg_prompt: Top-down photo of a 300mm silicon wafer on black background.
scenes.label: SLICING

scenes.vo: Inpe 'Films' yaani chemical ki patli parat chadhai jaati hai.
scenes.title: DEPOSITION
scenes.bg_prompt: Cross-section render of a wafer showing alternating thin-film layers in false color.
scenes.label: DEPOSITION

scenes.vo: EUV light se design chhapte hain, ye floor-by-floor baar-baar hota hai.
scenes.prompt: ASML EUV lithography tool in clean room, cyan laser line indicating beam path.
scenes.title: LITHOGRAPHY

real.q: EUV lithography machine operation close up
real.subject: A dramatic, real photo of an EUV lithography machine in operation (focusing on the hardware, not the brand logo).

scenes.bg_prompt: Photorealistic shot of an ASML EUV scanner in a semiconductor fab.
scenes.label: PHOTOLITHOGRAPHY

scenes.vo: 'Plasma' yaani garam gas faltu hissa hata kar rasta banati hai.
scenes.title: ETCHING

real.subject: A controlled, industrial shot of plasma etching equipment, showing gas interaction, not a schematic.

scenes.bg_prompt: SEM-style cross-section of etched trenches in silicon, vertical sidewalls.
scenes.label: ETCHING

scenes.vo: 'Ion beam' yaani bijli ki gun se tiny switches ya transistors bante hain.
scenes.title: TRANSISTORS

real.subject: A close-up of an ion beam/implantation chamber in a semiconductor fab.

scenes.bg_prompt: Ion implanter beamline end station, subtle blue glow of ion beam.
scenes.label: ION IMPLANT

scenes.vo: 'Copper' ki baarik taarein in saari layers ko aapas mein jodti hain.
scenes.prompt: Microscopic view of copper interconnects and vias in a multi-layered chip.
scenes.title: WIRING

real.subject: A microscopic or highly detailed photo showing copper wiring/interconnects within a chip layer.

scenes.bg_prompt: High-magnification cross-section SEM of copper dual-damascene interconnects.
scenes.label: METALLIZATION

scenes.vo: Yahan 'Fab' khatam, ab wafer ko 'Die' yaani tukdon mein kaatenge.
scenes.title: DICING
scenes.bg_prompt: Wafer dicing saw cutting through a silicon wafer into individual dies.
scenes.label: ASSEMBLY START

scenes.vo: 'Package' matlab chip ka ghar, jo use motherboard se jodta hai.
scenes.prompt: Flip-chip BGA package showing the die on substrate with solder balls underneath.
scenes.title: PACKAGING

real.subject: A hand or robotic arm carefully placing a silicon die into a protective package (e.g., BGA/QFN style).

scenes.bg_prompt: Exploded view of a processor package: die, substrate, and connection balls.
scenes.label: PACKAGING

scenes.vo: Isme 11 se 13 weeks lagte hain, tab banti hai ek chip.
scenes.title: TIME TAKEN

real.subject: A high-quality, non-branded photo of a finished, packaged semiconductor chip ready for integration.

scenes.bg_prompt: Time-lapse style blur of a busy semiconductor fab floor.
scenes.label: SCALE

scenes.vo: Itni mehnat ke baad tera phone chalta hai. Agla kya dekhna hai?
scenes.bg_prompt: Extreme close-up of a finished processor die, light sweeping across the surface.
scenes.label: OUTRO

caption:
Rait se processor kaise banta hai? 🏗️
Ek chip banane mein 11-13 weeks aur saikdon steps lagte hain.
Agla tech process kaunsa dekhna hai? Comment mein batao! 👇

Music: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

claims.basis: ASML Source: 'Wafers are sliced from a salami-shaped bar of 99.99% pure silicon (known as an 'ingot')'.

claims.claim: EUV lithography uses 13.5 nm wavelength light.
claims.basis: ASML Source: 'extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light... 13.5 nm, which is used to produce some of the finest details of a chip'.
Wikipedia Source: '11–13 weeks being the industry average' for advanced semiconductor devices.

claims.claim: Wafers are transported in FOUPs with nitrogen.
claims.basis: Wikipedia Source: 'wafers are transported inside special sealed plastic boxes called FOUPs... contain an internal nitrogen atmosphere'.

claims.claim: Copper is used for wiring in modern chips.
claims.basis: Wikipedia Source: 'Copper is used in modern semiconductors for wiring.'

steps_learned: Using EUV light for design printing
Using ion beams to create transistors
missing_steps: Thermal oxidation (the process of growing a thin layer of silicon dioxide)
The role of FOUPs (sealed boxes) for transport
The concept of 'yield' (why not all chips work)
Photolithography specifics (the script mentions EUV but doesn't explain it's a light-based printing process)
unsourced: 11 to 13 weeks (The source says 11-13 weeks is the industry average, but advanced nodes can take up to 15 weeks; the script is slightly outdated/narrow on this specific range)
Bijli ki gun (This is a simplified metaphor for ion implantation, but not a standard technical term)
